subject: a sturdy German craftsman-merchant of the mid-1400s with a long full brown beard and shoulder-length hair, wearing a dark fur-trimmed wool gown over a plain tunic and a soft round cap, strong ink-stained hands of a metalworker, focused thoughtful eyes

panels.01-mainz: the walled medieval city of Mainz on the river Rhine around 1400, the great red sandstone cathedral towers rising above steep-roofed half-timbered houses, wooden cargo boats and floating mills on the river, morning light, wide establishing shot, early 15th century Germany
panels.02-strasbourg: {S} by candlelight in a cramped stone workshop in Strasbourg in 1439, quietly showing two partners a small wooden frame of four fitted pieces beside a heavy wooden press, lead ingots and goldsmith's tools on the bench, shuttered window, an air of secrecy and invention
panels.03-mould: {S} casting metal type in a 15th-century workshop, pouring a thin stream of glowing molten metal from a small iron ladle into a hand-held wooden type mould, a small furnace glowing, rows of tiny freshly cast metal letters on a tray, punches and files on the bench, intense concentration
panels.04-setting: {S} standing beside a slanted wooden type case with many small compartments, watching a young apprentice pick tiny metal letters one by one into a handheld composing stick, a finished block of set type in a wooden frame on the table, warm window light, Mainz workshop around 1452
panels.05-press: {S} pulling the long wooden bar of a large wooden screw printing press in a busy Mainz workshop around 1455, an assistant beating the type with two leather ink balls, freshly printed two-column Bible pages hanging on lines to dry overhead, stacks of paper and vellum, triumphant moment of the first printed Bible
panels.06-frankfurt: a crowded 1454 trade fair in Frankfurt among timber-framed houses, a clean-shaven Italian diplomat in his late forties in a plain dark grey clerical robe and black cap leaning over a wooden table to admire loose printed Bible pages, merchants watching, {S} standing proudly behind the table, no red robes, no white beards on the diplomat
panels.07-lawsuit: the long vaulted dining hall of a Franciscan friary in Mainz in November 1455, a notary in a dark robe writing a legal record at a desk, a well-dressed merchant raising two fingers to swear an oath, two quiet men in plain clothes standing to one side as observers, friars in brown habits at the far end, serious formal mood, no violence
panels.08-eltville: an elderly grey-bearded {S} at the castle of Eltville on the Rhine in 1465, receiving a folded court robe of fine cloth from a court official, the river and vineyards visible through an arched window, quiet dignity and recognition late in life
